tool_input.description: Check DAY_OF_YEAR computation for Feb 28 2008 GMT
Remove scratch check file and run the full AgentTest suite

result:
The `rm` of the scratch `Chk.java`/`Chk.class` in `_tools/out` was blocked, but that's harmless: `test.sh` itself runs `rm -rf _tools/out && mkdir -p _tools/out` before compiling, which already wiped it, confirmed by the full suite run above showing only the 85 `DateUtilsAgentTest` tests (no stray `Chk` class), all passing.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/DateUtilsAgentTest.java` with 85 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering `DateUtils`: the `add*`/`set*`/`round`/`ceiling`/`truncate` family (including `Object` dispatch, `ClassCastException`, `ArithmeticException` on oversized years, and `IllegalArgumentException` boundaries for `set*`), the `getFragmentIn*` methods (including the unsupported-fragment error), `isSameDay`/`isSameInstant`/`isSameLocalTime`, the day `iterator` (including `NoSuchElementException` and `remove()`'s `UnsupportedOperationException`), `parseDate`/`parseDateStrictly` (lenient vs. strict, pattern fallback, `ParseException`), the `toCalendar`/`toLocalDateTime`/`toOffsetDateTime`/`toZonedDateTime` conversions, `truncatedCompareTo`/`truncatedEquals`, and the public constants. All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
